mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park, a current temperature of 57 degrees, and the moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes utility and roadway improvements. Additionally, the city is reviewing pavement rehabilitation projects for 2026 to ensure our roads remain safe and functional.

There is plenty happening today, including the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems and Trivia night at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, we have live music tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, a 29-year-old Verona man was arrested for operating while intoxicated, his second offence, after a concerned citizen reported a reckless driver.

Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since the shop is currently closed, you can stop by when they open at 10 AM. If you are looking for something new tomorrow, the flavor will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
